**[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 29 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 27 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24 [Clockwork Belimarius](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2745) **Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 47 **Perception** +10; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +12 **Str** +2 **Dex** +4 **Con** +3 **Int** -5 **Wis** +2 **Cha** -5 **Wind-Up** 24 hours, DC 21, standby **Items** [clockwork wand](/Equipment.aspx?ID=30), _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [halberd](/Weapons.aspx?ID=26)_ --- **AC** 20 **Fort** +11 **Ref** +12 **Will** +8 **HP** 45 **Immunities** [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10), [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) attacks, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) **Resistances** physical 5 (except [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374), bludgeoning, or orichalcum) **Weaknesses** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56) 5, [orichalcum](/Equipment.aspx?ID=378) 5 **Clockwork Wand** The clockwork mage uses a mechanical wand as a focus to channel magical energy. This wand is built into the clockwork mage's chest, with only the crystal at the end exposed. The mage can Interact to the remove the wand, or someone else can remove it with a DC 25 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) check to [Disable a Device](/Actions.aspx?ID=69). The clockwork mage becomes unable to cast any spells except cantrips while the wand is removed.
When removed, the clockwork wand is a magic wand containing the last 1st-level innate spell the clockwork mage cast ([_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), if the clockwork Belimarius hasn't yet cast a 1st-level spell in this adventure). The spells are placed within the wand while the mage is created, and the creator can substitute other arcane spells of the appropriate level. --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** _halberd_ +16 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)), **Damage** 2d10+4 piercing plus dispelling critical **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 21, attack +13 - **Cantrips (2nd)** [Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280), [Tanglefoot](/Spells.aspx?ID=330) - **1st** [Color Spray](/Spells.aspx?ID=44), [Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), [Mage Armor](/Spells.aspx?ID=176) - **2nd** [Magnetic Repulsion](/Spells.aspx?ID=945), [Resist Energy](/Spells.aspx?ID=256) **Dispelling Critical** On a critical hit with a halberd Strike, shards of [noqual](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1419) built into the clockwork Belimarius glow green for a moment. Instead of inflicting additional damage with the critical hit, the clockwork Belimarius instead attempts a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check with a +18 bonus against one magical effect active on the target.
name: Clockwork Belimarius
